Counter-signals toward lower: Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #7, Glyceryl Oleate #8 refatting. Convention applies cleanly; claims ('sanft gereinigt', 'Intensiv') ignored (Section 4, 3.2).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Section 5 high anchor via W-RICH: prominent payload_lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #7 (waxy) converges with prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9; plus weak refatter Glyceryl Oleate #8 and humectant Panthenol #11 (R11 list, prominent). C2 strictly not met: no early silicone (payload lipid takes its place) and no distinct pearlizing/fatty-alcohol route besides HVO itself (Glyceryl Oleate is only a weak refatter). Counter-signals: HVO sits after Sodium Chloride #6 so its level is likely modest; guar mid-list; silicone-free. 'reichhaltige Formel' claim ignored (C7, W-RICH). Moderate confidence, neighbor moderate (N-ALT).
